name: research-paper-workflow
description: An evidence-first workflow from a testable scientific question and reproducible methods to figure-led results, manuscript drafting, independent review, and submission preparation.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a scientific question and verified results into a journal manuscript.
interface.longDescription: Define the question, document data and methods, and build the argument from core figures and tables. Repair missing evidence before strengthening the introduction, then write the conclusion and abstract. Includes independent review and submission checks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use idea-to-journal-paper from my current stage: define a testable question, document data and methods, and arrange verified core figures and tables into an argument. If the argument breaks, identify whether it needs a new display, a new analysis, or a narrower claim. Then strengthen the introduction and write the conclusion before the abstract. Stop at missing evidence or author approval; do not submit.
